action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Start with PM2 
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all; pm2 start /opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs 2>&1 | tail -10")
print("PM2:", stdout.read().decode())

import time
time.sleep(5)

# Check health
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s http://localhost:3000/health 2>&1 | head -5")
print("\nHealth:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
